descriptionChirho: A song or hymn, especially one sung in praise or worship; Greek ᾠδή (contracted from ἀοιδή) refers to a lyrical composition meant to be sung. All NT occurrences appear in contexts of worship and praise (Revelation's 'new song,' Colossians/Ephesians' 'spiritual songs'). Multilingual evidence: eng 'song(s),' spa 'canción/cánticos,' hin गीत (gīt, song), arb تَرنيمَة/أَناشيد (tarnīma/anāshīd, hymn/anthem), kor 노래(들) (norae, song), swa 'wimbo' (song/hymn). The split is singular (S79226) vs plural (S79227) with no semantic distinction.
